problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Bravo: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Charlie: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Echo: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Foxtrot: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Golf: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Hotel: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment India: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Juliet: size 40 cubic meters
* Shipment Kilo: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Lima: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Mike: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment November: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Oscar: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Papa: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Quebec: size 40 cubic meters
* Shipment Romeo: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Sierra: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Tango: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Uniform: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Victor: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Whiskey: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment X-ray: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Yankee: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Zulu: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment [1]: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment [2]: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment [3]: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment [4]: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment [5]: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment [6]: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment [7]: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment [8]: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment [9]: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment [10]: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment [11]: size 38 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
